premise: I poured $105,000 from my late husband’s IRA into a luxury portable sauna rental fleet with my stepson, securing a notarized 40% equity share and a lifetime wellness pod in my backyard; after a corporate retreat contract he forged a release, sold the fleet and name to a spa chain for $620,000, and mailed me a $3,500 check—I retrieved our agreement from a waterproof tube hidden beneath my hot tub, voided the sale, and now run 'Steam of Betrayal Saunas' where he scrubs cedar interiors in a towel embroidered 'Sweating the Details' while each rental contract prints his fraud case number.
